request_summary: Rerun the GEC suite on DEV with the corrected storage endpoint to prove issuer setup and restore before publishing.

actions.description: Applied the human-authorized endpoint override, prepared delegation manifests and delegated the same approved plan to QA-runner with a new run id.
After the blocked result, reverted the override and confirmed the configuration file is back to its committed placeholder plus the timeout fix.

outcome.detail: No run took place because of an access restriction on the shared table; publication still waits for a human decision.

friction.description: Two consecutive reruns were blocked by storage-side prerequisites (wrong account, then missing data-plane role) that could only be discovered by a read of the table.
